name: drawer
summary: Presents edge-attached task context in a native dialog with a real no-JavaScript destination.

agent.useWhen: A focused secondary task or inspector benefits from retaining the surrounding page context.
agent.avoidWhen: The task is not interruptive, needs a full page, or content should remain persistently visible.

invariants: Options are typed plain data; body and optional actions are separate host-admitted slots.
fallbackHref remains a real safe destination until showModal enhancement succeeds.
Native dialog top-layer, Escape, and focus behavior are retained; no-JavaScript activation follows fallbackHref.
Description is optional and, when present, is referenced by aria-describedby.
Derived IDs are id, id-title, and conditionally id-description and must be collision checked.
Adapter fragment has exactly one [[drawer]] slot.
